Let's check: interior top-left relative (lr=1, lc=1). lr odd, lc odd => cleared. So (1,1) black. Relative to interior's top-left corner starting (0,0) means interior cell at local (0,0) is global (min_r+1,min_c+1). So black when local row+col even. Yes matches rule. Border unchanged.

Need generate inputs. Grid dimensions arbitrary. Let's make small grids.

Edge cases: rectangle height or width <=2 has no interior -> unchanged. Rectangles of size 2x2, 1xN, Nx1 unchanged. Larger sizes produce pattern. Multiple rectangles.
